name: [Aotuman] Grab WeChat Articles
author: apoyl

sections.description:
Enter the WeChat Official Account article link in the editor, click “Grab WeChat Articles,” and the content will be automatically captured into the editor. This makes it very convenient for users to obtain WeChat article content.

Feature Overview

  • Supports displaying a WeChat article link input field next to the editor

  • Supports one-click grabbing of WeChat articles in both the block editor and classic editor

  • Supports one-click grabbing of WeChat Official Account articles

  • Supports one-click grabbing of images and text from WeChat Official Account articles

  • Supports automatic localization and conversion of grabbed images

Some of the above features are free. Click to purchase the paid version: Aotuman Plugin
You can also contact the developer via QQ: 3201361925 or email: 3201361925@qq.com
This plugin hereby declares: It is intended to help users grab compliant and original author-authorized WeChat content. Please do not use the articles for commercial or illegal purposes.

Recommended Plugin Pairing
Auto Sync Alibaba Cloud Object Storage OSS: Automatically syncs website images and attachments to Alibaba Cloud Object Storage OSS, separating images/attachments from website code and distributing traffic to make your website load faster.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

Upload apoyl-grabweixin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory

Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

Method 1:
In your website’s backend, go to Plugins -> Install Plugins, search for “Aotuman,” find the “Grab WeChat Articles” plugin, and install it with one click.

Method 2:

Upload apoyl-grabweixin to your site directory for installation.

Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu.
sections.faq:
Can the WordPress website normally access WeChat articles?

Of course, it is required.

How to use?

After activating this plugin, enter the WeChat article link in the post editor and click “Grab with One Click.”

How to contact me?

Add QQ: 3201361925, Email: 3201361925@qq.com, or click to purchase: Aotuman Plugin
